test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

The poet

P. and sonic texture

Q. to evoke rhythm

R. employs alliteration

S. in abstract verses
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **RQPS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The poet," which is correctly indicated by **part (R).**
 
• Following the subject, "employs alliteration" **(RQ)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the poet employs.
 
• **The next part,** "to evoke rhythm," starts the explanation about the purpose of employing alliteration, indicated by (P).
 
• **Ending with **"and sonic texture in abstract verses" (QS) completes the sentence by elaborating on the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **RQPS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (SPQR):** This option starts with "in abstract verses and sonic texture," which makes the sentence incomplete and does not establish a logical flow.
 
• **Option 3 (PSRQ):** This option starts with "and sonic texture to evoke rhythm," creating a fragmented sentence lacking logical coherence.
 
• **Option 4 (QPSR):** This option starts with "to evoke rhythm employs alliteration," which misses grammatical consistency and disrupts the meaning.
</ul
